headerDisplay: 🖥️ **Computer Control** — Wake and sleep your computers from HomeKit.
footerDisplay: Computers running the Go client will auto-register. You can also manage them below.

registrationPort.title: Registration Server Port
registrationPort.description: The port on which the plugin listens for client registrations.

groupAccessoryName.title: Group Accessory Name
groupAccessoryName.description: Name of the virtual accessory that controls all computers at once (Wake All / Sleep All).

antiSleepDeviceName.title: Anti-Sleep Device Name
antiSleepDeviceName.description: Name of the virtual switch that prevents all computers from sleeping. Siri will use this name — e.g. "Hey Siri, turn on Computer Sleep Prevention". Leave empty to disable.

antiSleepTimer.title: Anti-Sleep Timer (minutes)
antiSleepTimer.description: Auto-turn-off delay in minutes. 0 = unlimited (stays on until manually turned off).

enableGlobalScreensaverSwitch.title: Enable Global Screensaver Switch
enableGlobalScreensaverSwitch.description: When enabled, creates an 'All Screensavers' switch in HomeKit. Turning it ON sends screensaver command to all registered clients that have Remote Screensaver enabled. Acts as a push button (auto-resets to OFF after 1–2 seconds).

enableGlobalLockSwitch.title: Enable Global Lock Switch
enableGlobalLockSwitch.description: When enabled, creates a 'Lock Computers' switch in HomeKit. Turning it ON locks the screen on all online clients that have Remote Lock enabled. Does not put computers to sleep. Acts as a push button (auto-resets to OFF after 1–2 seconds).

enableGlobalVolumeSwitch.title: Enable Global Volume (Master Slider)
enableGlobalVolumeSwitch.description: When enabled, creates a 'Computer Volume' accessory in HomeKit. Moving the slider sets the same volume level on all clients that have 'Join Master Volume' enabled in their client app.

masterVolumeName.title: Master Volume Accessory Name
masterVolumeName.description: Display name for the Global Volume accessory in HomeKit. Used when Enable Global Volume is on.

ip.title: IP Address
ip.description: The local IP address of the computer.

port.title: Client Port
port.description: Port the Go client is listening on.
